The same thread said $PREDICT is today's most traded new Solana memecoin at $72.75M volume on about a $3.14M market cap with only about $158K liquidity, which the author reads as bot churn. Small account, secondhand data; verify before relying on it.

news.headline: Hunter Biden-themed LAPTOP memecoin down 26% after midterms despite a burn, citing Benzinga
news.detail: @bsktradernft (10K followers) wrote at 12:14 Berlin that, per Benzinga, the LAPTOP memecoin fell 26% right after the Democrats' midterm win even after burning part of its supply. About 86 views at time of sweep; secondhand report, verify with the original article.

news.headline: Upbit holds over $1.1B in $DOGE and $SHIB, per Arkham data
news.detail: @cryptodotnews (130K followers, verified) reported at 11:54 Berlin that Arkham data shows Upbit holding $819.8M in DOGE and $284.15M in SHIB, its largest holdings after BTC, ETH and SOL. About 735 views at time of sweep.

news.headline: X News: Pump.fun pays $1.5M to top squad in its Squads Competition, sparking backlash
news.detail: X's trending summary says the two-week Pump.fun Squads Competition drew nearly 1,000 squads and 4,700 participants. OGCALLERS won $1.5M, LarpFnF $750K and DRAINEDD $250K. Critics say the winners bundled and dumped tiny coins averaging about $2.9K market cap, and some squads were disqualified for rule breaks. The backlash ties in the accusations that featured KOL Slingoor rugged the BTC and LMAO coins. Co-founder Alon said there are lessons for future events. AI summary of X posts; verify.

news.headline: Binance and CZ call ShinyHunters' sale of 'Binance user records' a scam
news.detail: @BSCNWire (about 571K followers) reported at 11:48 Berlin that Binance is pushing back on the ShinyHunters hacking crew, which claims to be selling its user records. CZ called the listing a scam, and Binance says it has found no evidence of a breach of its systems.

news.headline: $MONTRA reportedly at an $18M market cap after a 12,082% 24-hour run
news.detail: @copytop_xbt (424 followers) posted at 11:42 Berlin that the Elysium launchpad token $MONTRA sits at an $18M market cap, up 12,082% in 24 hours, and that 15 top wallets put in $167K in the last day, all through the FOMO app rather than Pump.fun. Single small account with very low engagement; figures unverified. See the earlier rows on the CASHCAT holder threatening to dump $MONTRA.

news.headline: Traders share heavy memecoin losses as the sector sits about 79% below early 2025
news.detail: An X news story (updated 11:18 Berlin) says the memecoin category is down about 78.74% from early 2025 to roughly $26B market cap, and the Trump-branded token fell from a $72B peak to $340M. It is a summary of user posts, so treat the figures as approximate.

news.headline: Solana leads L1s with 19.1M monthly active addresses while SOL trades near $86
news.detail: An X news story (updated 09:47 Berlin) cites Token Terminal data showing 19.1M monthly active Solana addresses, a 46.3% share among L1s, while SOL trades around $86 to $88 after a 20% monthly drop ahead of Breakpoint London on November 15 to 17.

news.headline: Binance reportedly warns of an iOS flaw that lets malicious apps read wallet seed phrases
news.detail: @open4profit (148K followers) posted at 11:15 Berlin that Binance warns malicious apps can exploit an iOS security flaw to access seed phrases and private keys stored by other apps on the same device. This is a repost of the warning, not Binance's own post, so check Binance's official channels before acting. Update 11:30 Berlin: @cryptoamanclub (88K) names the malicious app as FomoPeek. Update 11:38 Berlin: @DasEvas1 posted that, per SlowMist, a public exploit called 'worse_query' lets a malicious app escape its sandbox and read other apps' data, including wallet data stored in plain text, on iOS 26.0 to 26.7.2 and 27.2.

news.headline: Pump.fun faces backlash over insider tactics after the Cupsey side-wallet findings
news.detail: An X news story (updated 09:59 Berlin) says critics such as TheS◎Lstice and Mystral argue Pump.fun has shifted memecoins from community culture to coordinated hype and fees, after investigations found Cupsey-linked wallets traded over 27,000 tokens since May and extracted about $1.74M. Traders say they are checking holder lists more closely and eyeing alternatives like StonkFun. This is a summary of posts on X and the allegations are unproven.

news.headline: BSCN: $TROLL and $HAROLD up while the Solana memecoin market stays flat
news.detail: @BSCNews (1.37M followers) reported at 06:47 Berlin that $TROLL rose 7% and $HAROLD 10% over 24 hours while, citing CoinGecko, the wider memecoin market was largely flat. Modest moves.

news.headline: Upbit and Bithumb list Hyperliquid's HYPE
news.detail: Small accounts @bluewingdex (111 followers) and @CoinXview (19 followers) report that Upbit, Korea's biggest exchange, scheduled HYPE trading for 15:00 KST (07:00 Berlin) today on its KRW, BTC and USDT markets, with deposits and withdrawals on HyperEVM only. Not a memecoin; not checked against Upbit's own notice here. At 06:13 Berlin a listing-alert account, @CryptoP1lot (127 followers), also reported HYPE and CARDS live on Bithumb spot, so both big Korean exchanges are now listing HYPE. At 06:30 Berlin @dev_kratos (573 followers) also cited Upbit's notice: trading opens 06:00 UTC (07:00 Berlin) today, HyperEVM transfers only.

news.headline: Bitrue lists $牛逼, $GM and $STANK on Bitrue Alpha
news.detail: @BitrueOfficial (409K followers) announced at 06:00 Berlin that the three tokens are live on its Bitrue Alpha section. It says $牛逼 rides the hype around Elon Musk's viral 'Chinese X is 牛逼' post, and $GM is a BSC-based meme coin. Alpha is Bitrue's early-stage on-chain section, not a main spot listing. Tracker @OctoToolsLive (1.8K followers) listed $STANK as its top 24h mover, from about $89.7K to $4.09M market cap (its own figures).

news.headline: X News: North Korea-linked Binance hackers launched memecoins to launder stolen funds
news.coins: Short-lived memecoins on NEAR, Tron and Solana
news.detail: X's trending summary says Elliptic found that the TraderTraitor group, which the FBI blames for the 29 Oct 2026 Binance hack (put at $6.4B), minted memecoins for about $90 each, paired them with liquidity pools and pushed about $430,000 of stolen NEAR through fake trades. The same tactic was seen after the 2025 Bybit hack. Binance has pledged to cover user losses. First seen via a small account, @Prowlytics, at 05:56 Berlin.

news.headline: X News: top $MONTRA holder threatens to dump over CASHCAT rug accusations
news.detail: X's trending summary says a holder posting as igotruggedoncashcat, who claims a $2M loss after Spinor left the $CASHCAT takeover to build $MONTRA on Elysium, holds around 5% of $MONTRA supply across wallets and has vowed to dump to block any rise. Analysts warn of selling pressure and the price has swung wildly. One side of a dispute; unverified. Builds on the earlier @remusofmars and @YakuzaDaddy rows.

news.headline: @remusofmars: 'Spinor' talked me into $2M+ of $CASHCAT, then launched another launchpad
news.detail: @remusofmars (39,012 followers) posted 'Spinor files' at 03:41 Berlin, saying Spinor convinced them to put over $2M into $CASHCAT on the promise that his Let'sCash launchpad would build a flywheel around the token, and that less than two months later Spinor announced another launchpad on Elysium. One side of the story; not verified. About 579 views, 8 likes so far.

news.headline: Hens.farm rug: on-chain report traces funds to a known Chikn whale
news.detail: @_lilrag (1,630 followers) published an X article titled 'Hens.farm rug | The full report' at 03:36 Berlin, saying it follows the money to a known Chikn whale. Small reach so far (about 43 views, 3 likes); claims not independently verified.

news.headline: Jensen Huang joke coins cool off: $PUSSY down 55%, Big Titty Coin down 31% in 24h
news.detail: @HawkFi_ (68,283 followers) posted its 24-hour trending list at 03:00 Berlin: $PUSSY, a meme riffing on the Jensen Huang affair story, is down 55% on the day after an all-time-high market cap of $3.33M; Big Titty Coin ($BTC), an older meme revived by the same joke, is down 31% after an ATH market cap of $21.9M. Figures as posted, not verified.

news.headline: Pump.fun adds "Diamond" callout rewards that favor bigger caps and longer holds
news.detail: X News story (updated 01:51 Berlin): Pump.fun rolled out a Diamond Callout Rewards algorithm next to its original Degen version, paying more for calls on larger market cap tokens and longer holds to cut spam. Co-founder Alon called it an experiment; the program has paid millions in USDC since early 2026. Analyst dethective says top callers' followers lost $2.4M overall, fuelling debate about protecting copy traders. AI-generated summary; not verified.

news.headline: Top CASHCAT holder snipes 5% of new Elysium launchpad token $MONTRA, alleging a rug
news.detail: Posts from @YakuzaDaddy (about 36K followers) and others say a top $CASHCAT holder claims CASHCAT lead @spinor_ sold out of CASHCAT to start the Montra launchpad on Elysium, and that he sniped 5% of the launchpad token $MONTRA in revenge. These are unproven claims from X posts with modest engagement (7 likes on the main post).

news.headline: Bubblemaps accuses Solana trader Cupsey of a $1.7M side-wallet scheme
news.detail: X News story (updated 01:30 Berlin): Bubblemaps mapped about 30 wallets it links to Cupsey (about 234K followers), saying side wallets bought early, his public wallet followed to pull in copy traders, and the side wallets sold into the pump for about $1.74M since May 7. It also ties the wallets to a deployer that launched and rugged thousands of tokens. Cupsey answered with a meme. AI-generated summary; allegations, not verified.

news.headline: World Liberty Financial starts WLFI token buybacks on Aster
news.detail: X News story (updated 00:25 Berlin): the Trump-linked project loaded $10M in USD1 into a public wallet and began gradual WLFI buybacks, funded by part of USD1 revenue. Purchases are live onchain at around $0.0499 to $0.0500 per token; co-founder Zak Folkman confirmed the start. AI-generated summary; not verified.

news.headline: Backable pulls PercolatorTrade's $250K raise after holder backlash
news.detail: X News story (updated 02:13 Berlin): MetaDAO's Solana fundraising platform Backable delisted the raise for the new $PERC token because the team abandoned $PERCOLATOR holders with no swap or airdrop. The old token fell about 90% in hours and ZachXBT called it a rug. Backable changed its stance from permissionless to open to allow basic moderation; a developer plans to fork the open-source code. AI-generated summary; not verified.

news.headline: PEPE up about 7% while most crypto dipped
news.detail: X News story (updated 01:30 Berlin): on Nov 9 PEPE gained about 7% to trade near $0.00000534 with a $2.15B market cap and high volume, outperforming Dogecoin and Shiba Inu, which fell. Traders shared breakout charts; at least one shorted it, calling it range-bound. AI-generated summary; not verified.

news.headline: Float launchpad accused of 'vamping' existing Solana memecoins
news.detail: X News story (updated 00:12 Berlin): Float, a Solana launchpad launched in late October that promised to stop copycat 'vamp' launches, is accused of its users doing exactly that to coins like $DOPE (a Doge-Pepe hybrid). The summary says the drama has pushed $FLOAT down from its peaks. Solana trader Unipcs ('Bonk Guy') also vented about trading backlash in a related trending thread. AI-generated summary; no prices given.

news.headline: Charles Schwab adds Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink trading
news.detail: X News story (updated 23:22 Berlin): Schwab Crypto now offers SOL, AVAX and LINK alongside BTC and ETH for eligible clients, at a 0.75% fee per trade, per the summary. Not a memecoin listing, but SOL is the main memecoin chain.

news.headline: CoinJar lists Pump.fun's $PUMP
news.detail: CoinJar (@GetCoinJar, 13.8K followers, verified) posted at 23:00 Berlin that PUMP can now be bought and sold on CoinJar and CoinJar Exchange. Low engagement at scan (16 impressions).
